endorsements.quote: In this regard, clinicians, public health experts, and system developers ought to be cognisant of the multidimensional risk, engaging person with nuanced levels of lived experience in addition to clinical expertise.

It seems that mental health professionals have a role to play in education on the likely limitations of common LLMs for mental health support, and a potential need for AI LLM use screening in some contexts (Hudon and Stip 2025).

unlisted_practices: Conduct large-scale population studies to understand at-risk groups and risk factors for adverse mental health outcomes from generic LLM use.
Conduct robust experimental research focused on youth to determine the benefits and risks of LLM chatbots for mental health support.
Consider screening for AI LLM use in some clinical contexts.

screen.reason: This is a perspective paper outlining considerations and recommendations regarding the deployment, risks, and governance of LLM chatbots for youth mental health.
